summary_en: Tender price raised to ¥3,570/share from ¥3,450. Warrants tendered at ¥1 each. Tender period extended to 2026-08-27 (75 business days, from prior 67 business days ending 2026-08-17). Board recommendation unchanged. Minimum tender threshold 34,941,000 shares. Offeror: Kamgras 1 K.K. (advised by Bain Capital PE and LINE Yahoo Corporation).
title_en: Amendment notice - Kakaku.com Inc. opinion and recommendation on Kamgras 1 K.K. public tender offer for company shares - amendment to disclosure dated 2026-08-03
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-14, Kakaku.com Inc. announced an amendment to its board opinion and shareholder recommendation regarding the Kamgras 1 K.K. public tender offer for the company's shares (a going-private transaction). The offeror—Kamgras 1 K.K., advised by Bain Capital Private Equity and LINE Yahoo Corporation—increased the tender price for ordinary shares from ¥3,450 to ¥3,570 per share, effective from a revised tender offer filing submitted 2026-08-13. All outstanding warrants (eight series issued 2016–2025) are tendered at ¥1 each. The tender period has been extended from the original 67 business days (ending 2026-08-17) to 75 business days (ending 2026-08-27). The board's recommendation that shareholders tender remains unchanged; the special committee formed to evaluate the going-private transaction has reiterated its advisory opinion. Minimum tender threshold is 34,941,000 shares.
